opening: The record concerns an icebound research vessel changing watches during a storm. By the time investigators reconstructed the emergency ballast release, casual impressions had produced several plausible candidates. The reviewers therefore used only the local rules stated in the surviving record.

scenes.prose: Before comparing names, the panel read the governing notes aloud. For this incident, the board declared the concordant watchkeeper protocol active; ordinary rank and reputation did not count. The panel fixed one shared status scale for the whole inquiry: waking counted as 0; open counted as 1; stable counted as 2; dormant counted as 3; latent counted as 4; clear counted as 5. The local tally began at 16. In order it used relation, temporal, causal, spatial, sequence, and protocol statuses with coefficients 2, 5, 13, 3, 11, 7. At each stream, the panel squared the current tally, added that stream's coefficient times its status value, and kept the remainder modulo 97. It made three passes: first in the stated order, then in reverse order with the coefficients reversed, then once more in the stated order with the coefficient list rotated one place left. Without resetting the tally, it repeated that complete three-pass cycle 125 times.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 1

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. When the pairing sheet was recovered, Zion Ortiz's mentor pennant stood at latent. Even the damaged roster still marked Finley Brooks's mentor pennant as stable. A clock-backed entry listed Eden Rossi's watch interval as clear. The alarm consequence that followed Kai Dubois registered as stable. Causal review marked Winter Novak's alarm consequence waking. Door and route checks placed Zion Ortiz's assigned station at latent. Witnesses in the corridor put Finley Brooks's assigned station at dormant. Reconstruction kept Eden Rossi's handover order at clear. A close photograph of the token set Kai Dubois's seal notch to latent. At final count, Winter Novak's seal notch remained open.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 2

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. A witness who checked the roster left Kai Dubois with a dormant mentor pennant. On the sealed worksheet, clerks wrote clear beside Winter Novak's mentor pennant. Clocked entries put Zion Ortiz's watch interval at dormant. The sequence sheet showed Finley Brooks's watch interval as latent. Downstream checks tied Eden Rossi to a open alarm consequence. A movement sketch marked Kai Dubois's assigned station as stable. The route ledger tied Winter Novak's assigned station to open. In the ordered log, Zion Ortiz's handover order appeared as open. The ordered sheet showed Finley Brooks's handover order as latent. Inventory counted Eden Rossi's seal notch as clear.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 3

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. In the earlier pairing note, Eden Rossi carried a open mentor pennant. After the timesheet review, Kai Dubois's watch interval stayed waking. Reconciled timing notes kept Winter Novak's watch interval at stable. Instruments tracing Zion Ortiz's action left the alarm consequence latent. When Finley Brooks acted, the alarm consequence came back dormant. Location review left Eden Rossi's assigned station waking. Sequence notes placed Kai Dubois's handover order at waking. At sequence review, Winter Novak's handover order stayed stable. Token and seal checks left Zion Ortiz's seal notch at stable. The sealed check showed Finley Brooks's seal notch as dormant.
scenes.title: Reconstruction 4

scenes.prose: The inquiry moved from recollection to checked records. For this incident, the accepted tally was 7. The final definition was strict: the concordant watchkeeper was the one person whose six-stream tally equaled the accepted tally.
